title: WCAG 2.2 Level A accessibility gate
event: Interface changes can merge with no deterministic WCAG 2.2 Level A result.
pattern: Accessibility depends on someone remembering to audit, so regressions merge between reviews.
structure: Repository CI validated the build and had no shared accessibility or diff-hygiene workflow.
archetype: Shifting the Burden: manual review substitutes for a missing structural gate.
intervention: Call the SHA-pinned reusable accessibility and diff-hygiene workflows, and declare ui:false so the no-UI path stays explicit.
leading_indicators: Pull requests show level-a and diff-hygiene results from the pinned reusable workflows.
transfer: Other repositories can call the same pinned workflows with their own .a11y.yml declaration.
